x: Eddie Short is now the Officer-in-charge of Athletics at the R.A.F. Halton Camp and his C/O is none other than the old Olympic hurdler, Don Finlay.

More important, the generation of pre-war stars that had carried on after the war such as Sydney Wooderson and Don Finlay were now being supplanted by a new generation of athletes, some of whom were only at the beginning of high calibre careers.
